title: ModelLifecycleRequest
description: An agent asking the operator to make a model ready on a provider, or to release it, over NATS request and reply on kubemoot.provider.model.<provider>. The operator's engine adapter carries it out. Only engines that put models to sleep (vLLM) take it; Ollama loads on demand and is never asked.

action.description: ready wakes the model's server (putting the awake one on the same accelerator to sleep first); release puts it to sleep.

model.description: The model, by the name the provider serves it under.

agent.description: The agent asking, for the operator's log.
